caveats: Plaintiff Tatyanna Presnell filed a claim against the City of Spokane in September 2022 (originally seeking $1 million) over on-duty rape by SPD officer Nathan Nash; settled for $300,000, approved March 2024. Nash was convicted at trial in 2022 of rape counts (third-degree rape of Presnell; second-degree rape of another woman) and sentenced Oct 13, 2022 to 172 months (about 14 years) to life; sources say he was appealing. Defendant in the civil matter is the City of Spokane; agency listed as Spokane Police Department (employing agency). Three KREM.com sources timed out and were skipped.
